task: Complete Phase 12 integration on branch feat/phase-12-android-companion. The shared Android JSON-line contract is b60bd0b and bounded transport/lifecycle core is 09b8ea3. Prior integration correctly found a blocker: start/serve creates a fresh Session per TCP connection, so replay state does not survive reconnect. First make a minimal core-native fix: retain WireFrame/canonical/HMAC/bounds semantics; add a synchronized in-memory session registry in the transport runtime keyed by client_id plus session_id (or safe client identity for pairing); every connection authenticates against and updates persistent Session before handler invocation; no key/counter persistence or key exposure; keep idempotent stop and active-connection closure; add tests for cross-connection replay, independent clients, wrong MAC, and stop/port closure; preserve existing callers. Then add in-memory CompanionTransportManager/State around TransportHandle/EphemeralPairing, typed Rust request/status/result structures, and Tauri commands for explicit Owner-confirmed start/stop/status. Start rejects temporary chat/safe mode/invalid agent-owner, requires ownerConfirmed=true, defaults to 127.0.0.1, permits RFC1918 only with explicit private confirmation, rejects wildcard/public, uses bounded ephemeral port, consumes one-time pairing key only in memory, returns raw pairing code only in start result to Owner/UI and never logs/persists it; stop uses lifecycle shutdown; status redacts secrets; initialize AppState/test_state/register handlers; add concise Portuguese UI and TypeScript invoke contracts. Wire authenticated bounded frames to real companion authority: pair calls start_companion_pairing; session/reconnect calls existing methods; history/list and queue_preview/approve/cancel/retry call existing Database methods; deserialize existing request structs with exact proof/idempotency/temporaryChat/Owner gates; bounded typed JSON responses; reject malformed/unknown/oversized payloads, wrong MAC, replay, revoked/temporary requests; never return paths/media/secrets; add temporary-Database localhost TCP integration test for auth/pair/session/history or queue, replay rejection and stop closure. Complete Android explicit-connect-only integration (no auto-connect/scan/listen), SecureStore load/save/rotation/revocation with no raw-secret logs, pairing/session handshake, HMAC/replay checks, bounded history/queue, timeout/reconnect, offline fallback, deterministic loopback/offline JVM tests. Update PHASE_12_ANDROID_IMPLEMENTATION.md, PHASE_12_ANDROID_SPEC.md, ROADMAP.md, KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md, CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md, README.md honestly: real APK/authenticated local-private loopback/deterministic tests complete; physical device/private LAN/manual/release signing reserved; Phase 13 BielOS/Cloudflare separate. Run cargo fmt/check/clippy/full/focused tests; contracts typecheck/build/tests; desktop typecheck/tests/build; Android absolute-toolchain gradle test/lint/assembleDebug; APK SHA-256; secrets scan; diff check; clean status. Commit exactly feat: integrate phase 12 companion transport. No push/publish/PR/merge/tag/release/deploy/BielOS/native subagents/direct edits.
constraints: Use only configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
Use committed shared wire/lifecycle APIs and smallest compatible core extension needed for persistent authenticated sessions.
Transport is explicit, authenticated, bounded, local/private-only by default, fail-closed; no relay/public listener/telemetry/Python exposure.
Use absolute checkout-local Android toolchain paths; ignored .tooling is never committed.
No remote mutation, BielOS import, Phase 13 external integration, or release claim.

review_findings.title: Persistent authenticated session state is required before Tauri integration
review_findings.details: Previous integration stopped before editing because one-frame server reset Session on every connection. Fix this in transport runtime with an in-memory synchronized registry and prove cross-connection replay rejection, then complete requested integration.
